verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical horizontal crops. Each keeps a blurry middle slice of the photo, so the hero fig toast is cut to unreadable fragments on the right. Each also shrinks the wreath lockup into a small centred stamp that floats off-axis in a lot of dead blurred space, and its right half sits over the busy fig wedge. A's 'Perfect Taste' type is slightly larger and pushes against the inside edge of the wreath, so it looks cramped. B's slightly smaller type sits more cleanly inside the wreath ring, which is marginally closer to the original lockup. Neither resize rearranges the design for the banner format.
